TZA.note: The Bank of Tanzania is said to supervise payment systems including mobile money platforms, but licensing is not stated.

facts.fact: The Bank of Tanzania's financial consumer protection department takes unresolved complaints about banks, microfinance institutions and mobile money providers through a digital screening system that sends customers to their provider first; it received over 1,500 complaints in 2024.
facts.system: Bank of Tanzania digital complaints platform

systems.system: Bank of Tanzania digital complaints platform

TZA.note: The platform takes complaints about financial providers, not public services.
Nothing on government payments to people.
Mobile money platforms are named only as supervised; no service is described.
